label: character and personality adjectives
note: achha was the only disposition word the track had. Chapter 91 adds six: buraa (bad), hoshiyaar (clever), mehnati (hard-working), sharmeela (shy), milansaar (sociable) and gambhir (serious). These are settled character rather than mood, which is the distinction the point turns on, and the sharmeela lesson makes it explicit: the -ila ending builds a standing trait where -i would only say the person has the thing.
